bio: Rhett William Marques (born December 3, 1972) is an American politician and businessman serving as a Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives from the 91st district. He assumed office on November 7, 2018.
offices: Member of the Alabama House of Representatives

items.t: Voted to increase Alabama's state fuel tax as part of the Rebuild Alabama Act (2019).
items.q: In 2019, Marques voted to increase Alabama's state fuel tax, as part of the Rebuild Alabama Act.
